items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: I remember playing with Manny Perez a couple of times after he started to renew a band

ctx.x: They had to just have a keno game a while before they should stop it. I don't know why, what reason they would stop a keno game or a bingo game and let racehorses go out, I don't know why. Never to try to seek and find out why, but you could play a card for a nickel, you go to the track you gotta pay at least two dollars to bet on the horse. People used to come home on a Saturday night with their bag of groceries, with their basket of groceries under their arm that they won at the keno game, you know, and this…
Which street did he live on?
